title: Age-band pricing: agency and template age bands, quotes that fill quantities from travellers' ages or the children's ages read from a message, one shared band resolver
goal: An agency defines its age bands (labels and ages) once, a template can override them, and a quote fills its band quantities from the travellers' dates of birth or from 'two adults and kids aged 8 and 5' in one step instead of editing lines.
why: Gap 7: every family quote with children's age bands is edited line by line today. Design: TOUR-OPERATOR-DESIGN.md sections 4.2 and 14.

edit: desktop/src/app/(app)/itineraries/[id]/** (builder line band select and the Fill quantities action only)

steps: backend services/pricing/age-bands.ts and desktop lib/age-bands.ts with the same tests: bandsFor(templateBands?, agencyBands), bandForAge(bands, age) where each band covers [minAge, next minAge), ageOn(dob, date) in whole years (and fractional for display), fillQuantities(items, bands, {adults, ages}) -> changes per line (band lines -> count in band; per_person lines -> total pax; others unchanged).
Default agency bands adult 12+, child 2-11, infant 0-1 (design 4.2) under settings key pricing.age_bands (GET/PUT /settings/age-bands); existing pax_type values adult, child and infant keep working.
R143's local resolver in services/departures/passengers.ts is replaced by this module (behaviour identical for default bands; its tests stay green).
0060: itinerary_templates ADD age_bands; itineraries ADD age_bands, pax_ages; schema; bundle.
Template editor: an Age bands card (inherit agency bands, or a custom list with label and minimum age); item rows pick a band or 'per person' for pax_type.
POST /itinerary-templates/create-from accepts {adults?, ages?} and fills quantities on creation; copies the bands snapshot.

POST /itineraries/:id/fill-quantities {source: ages|travellers|lead, ages?, travellerIds?} returns a preview; ?apply=1 applies and recomputes totals. 'lead' uses the lead's pax counts and the latest message analysis childAges (R140).
Itinerary page: a 'Fill quantities' action opening fill-quantities-dialog (enter ages, or pick travellers of the lead's contact, or use the lead) with the preview diff before applying.

The assistant's create_itinerary_from_template action passes {adults, ages} from the analysis so the one-click quote already has the right quantities; the suggestion reason mentions them ('2 adults, children 8 and 5').

tests: backend/test/age-bands.test.ts: band boundaries (11.9 -> child, 12 -> adult with default bands; a four-band list), age on the travel date, fill from ages, travellers' DOBs and the lead with childAges; per-person lines; feature age_band_pricing off -> the routes answer 403 and create-from ignores ages; the assistant action creates a quote with filled quantities.
desktop vitest: lib/age-bands.ts (same table as the backend).

e2e/age-bands.spec.ts: set four agency bands, a template with band lines, create a quote from it for a lead with 'kids aged 8 and 5' in its message (rule reader), quantities and total match; refill from travellers changes them.
acceptance: A family quote from a template has correct band quantities without editing lines.
Agencies that never set bands see the same quotes as before.

cd desktop && npx tsc --noEmit && npx tsc -p electron/tsconfig.json --noEmit
cd desktop && npx vitest run   # 0 failing files; passed >= the count at the last merge

productRules: Generic product: no prospect or customer names anywhere.
Feature switch: age_band_pricing (all plans) on the new routes and UI.
